summary: Implementation plan for resizing the 5 Live Radio station switches inside SourcePrism3D (Facet 0) into a 2-column grid with a full-width 5th switch, enabling 2-line wrapped station names with responsive text sizing, and applying the aviator cockpit latching switch theme (ck-key) to all SourcePrism3D controls (station boxes, top source tabs, and prev/next buttons).
